::: {#exr-zero-one-cutoff}

#### A rule for 0 or 1

Call an image a 1 when its center ink, from @sol-zero-or-one, is above a cutoff,
and a 0 otherwise.
Choose a cutoff for the 0s and 1s,
with the interactive plot on the course website or with code.
How many of those images does your rule get wrong?

:::
